audit.method: independent stage-2 audit, 2026-10-03: re-fetched every cited source live (curl). Westfield and Ettinger HTML pages differ byte-wise from the pins (pages do on every request) and Ettinger's generated datasheet PDFs differ too, so facts were read from the live text; Westfield's DIN 985 PDF, DJI's O4 manual and MEPS's two images matched their pinned sha256 and were read from those bytes (the images visually). The generated bodies were measured with ext-parts scripts/audit/step_measure.py. Every sourced fact the part states was checked; these small parts state fewer than 12 sourced facts each, so the count includes the gap, assumption and CAD checks.
